pairs: Habitavit autem Jacob in terra Chanaan,
Now Jacob lived in the land of Canaan,
in qua pater suus peregrinatus est.
Joseph, when he was sixteen years old,
pascebat gregem cum fratribus suis adhuc puer:
was pasturing the flock with his brothers, when he was still a boy.
et erat cum filiis Balæ et Zelphæ uxorum patris sui:
And he was with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, the wives of his father.
accusavitque fratres suos apud patrem crimine pessimo.
And he accused his brothers to their father of a most sinful crime.
Israël autem diligebat Joseph super omnes filios suos,
Now Israel loved Joseph above all his sons,
eo quod in senectute genuisset eum:
because he had conceived him in his old age.
And he made him a tunic, woven of many colors.
Videntes autem fratres ejus quod a patre plus cunctis filiis amaretur,
Then his brothers, seeing that he was loved by his father more than all his other sons,
oderant eum, nec poterant ei quidquam pacifice loqui.
hated him, and they were not able to say anything peacefully to him.
Accidit quoque ut visum somnium referret fratribus suis:
Then it also happened that he recounted the vision of a dream to his brothers,
quæ causa majoris odii seminarium fuit.
for which reason a greater hatred began to be nurtured.
“Listen to my dream that I saw.
putabam nos ligare manipulos in agro:
I thought we were binding sheaves in the field.
et quasi consurgere manipulum meum, et stare,
And my sheaf seemed to rise up and stand,
vestrosque manipulos circumstantes adorare manipulum meum.
and your sheaves, standing in a circle, reverenced my sheaf.”

Hæc ergo causa somniorum atque sermonum,

Quid nobis prodest si occiderimus fratrem nostrum, et celaverimus sanguinem ipsius?

and then our hands will not be defiled.
frater enim et caro nostra est.
